question: In Model 1, when does the waist detection fall back to the proportional estimate, and how is the result labelled?
ground_truth: when the narrowest point lies outside 0.35 to 0.65 of the torso height; the waist is set at 0.55 of the torso and labelled proportional_fallback with low confidence

question: How many profiles are pre-computed offline for the recommendation engine, and why is this done instead of running the model live?
ground_truth: 400 profiles (4 sizes x 5 body shapes x 5 occasions x 4 seasons); the neural pipeline needs a GPU and the application should stay within free-tier limits
difficulty_rationale: Requires retrieving the number of profiles and the design reason behind it.

question: Why did the landmark baseline give a hip estimate of 19.5 cm while the segmentation-based method gave 61.9 cm for the same photograph?
ground_truth: the hip landmarks are internal joint centres, so their distance is smaller than the body width at the hips; the segmentation method reads the silhouette width at hip height instead
difficulty_rationale: Requires explaining the cause of a measurement discrepancy, not just quoting the two numbers.

question: How is the final score of an outfit computed in the recommendation engine, and what two safeguards are applied during selection?
ground_truth: final = 0.6 x compatibility + 0.4 x relevance - 0.1 x colour penalty; a compatibility floor of 0.55 removes outfits with a weak pair, and a per-item reuse cap of 2 limits how many accepted outfits can share a product
difficulty_rationale: Requires synthesizing the scoring formula with two separate safeguards from the same section.

question: How does the virtual try-on pipeline handle an outfit made of a top and a bottom, and which stages are added around LaDI-VTON?
ground_truth: garment cleaning, person preparation and identity restoration are added around the model; because it changes one clothing region at a time, the bottom is generated first and its result becomes the person image for the top
difficulty_rationale: Requires combining the added stages with the sequential layering order.

result of the first step becomes the person image

question: Why does the report say the 0.932 accuracy should not be attributed to the neural network, and what does the metadata-only accuracy of 0.928 suggest about the labels?
ground_truth: 0.932 is the linear model's own performance because the ensemble weight was 0; metadata-only reaching 0.928 suggests the proxy labels depend mainly on category and colour
difficulty_rationale: Requires connecting the ensemble result with the ablation result to interpret what the accuracy actually measures.
